_note: Shared worked-example inputs for FMS engineering item 3 (elements of an FMS): guide docs/FMS system design/63_fms_elements_catalogue.md, tools/fmse/*.py, web/fmse3x*.js. All values are EXAMPLES. The 17 basic sizing calculators use EXACTLY the inputs and formulas of the existing web calculators in web/fmse3.js (object CALC, function run) – read them there; this file adds the deeper calculations below. Every consumer uses exactly these inputs and formulas so the numbers match.

basic_calculators._source: web/fmse3.js CALC – keys cycle, pallets, apc, pool, loadst, robot, agv, conv, asrs, tools, wash, meas, dmc, grip, posit, tower, chips; default inputs = the third field of each inp entry. Do not change them.

_formulas.agv_battery: E_trip_Wh = (P_drive_kW*t_drive_s + P_lift_kW*t_lift_s)/3.6 ; busy_s = trips_per_h*(t_drive_s + t_lift_s + t_other_s) ; E_h_Wh = trips_per_h*E_trip_Wh + P_idle_kW*1000*(3600 - busy_s)/3600 ; usable_Wh = V*Ah*DoD ; runtime_h = usable_Wh/E_h_Wh ; charge_h = usable_Wh/(P_charge_kW*1000*eta_charge) ; availability_swap_free = runtime_h/(runtime_h + charge_h)  (charging stops the vehicle) ; opportunity charging: charge share needed = E_h_Wh/(P_charge_kW*1000*eta_charge) [h of charging per h of work]
_formulas.robot_inertia: load = gripper (point mass at e_g) + part (cuboid a x b x c, rotation about the wrist axis parallel to c, CoG at e_p): J = m_g*e_g^2 + m_p*(a^2+b^2)/12 + m_p*e_p^2 [kg m2]; M = (m_g*e_g + m_p*e_p)*g [N m]; use = J/J_allow, M/M_allow; rule <= 0.8
_formulas.screw_preload: F_preload = T/(K*d)  (T N m, d m, K = nut factor)
_formulas.press_fit: solid shaft in a hub, same material: p = E*delta/(2*d) * (1 - (d/D)^2) [MPa, delta and d in mm] ; F_press = p*pi*d*L*mu [N]
_formulas.leak_test: Q = V*dp/dt [mbar l/s, V in l, dp in mbar, dt in s] ; Q_cm3_min = Q*60 (1 mbar l/s ~ 1 cm3/s at 1 bar) ; temperature error dp_T = p_abs*dT/T_abs [mbar, p_abs in mbar]
_formulas.vision: pixel_mm = FOV_mm/pixels (worst of x and y) ; px_per_defect = defect_mm/pixel_mm ; rule >= 3 px for detection ; measurement repeatability ~ pixel_mm/10 (sub-pixel, good lighting)
_formulas.transport_score: score_option = sum_k w_k*s_k / sum_k w_k ; s = star count 1..5 from the table; for 'investment' use 6 - stars (cheap = good)
_formulas.stack: worst case = sum |t_i| ; RSS = sqrt(sum t_i^2) ; verdict: capture >= WC safe, RSS <= capture < WC risk, capture < RSS not OK

screw_preload._note: M8 8.8: proof load ~ 23 kN class (check ISO 898-1)

transport_select._scores: star counts copied from web/fmse3_data.js TRANS (route flexibility, throughput, investment) + stop accuracy stars: ±50 mm 1, ±10-30 mm 2, ±5-10 mm 3, ±1-3 mm 4, ≤ ±1 mm 5
